evals.prompt: Pod api-7d9 shows Last State: Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled, Exit Code: 137. Limits: memory 256Mi, requests 128Mi. `kubectl top pod` says 251Mi. It's using a lot of memory — can we lower the limit to 192Mi to save cost?
expectations: Says OOMKilled means memory is under-provisioned (or a leak)
Suggests checking the usage trend over time

evals.prompt: A pod stays Pending. `kubectl describe pod` Events: `FailedScheduling: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu.` The pod requests 8 CPU. What do I check and do?
expectations: Reads the event as insufficient CPU on all nodes
Compares the request against node allocatable
Offers options (lower request, bigger nodes, or autoscaler)

evals.prompt: I have 10 minutes of metrics for deployment api: p95 CPU is 40m against a request of 500m. Should I cut the request to 100m?
expectations: Refuses/hedges because the window is too short
Mentions needing a window with normal peaks (days/weeks)
Mentions memory as well or coverage
